summary: Strengthen exam-style inverse and determinant practice and make the identity check explicit.

improvements.why: Existing inverse items usually request one entry; learners need practice finding and verifying an entire inverse.
improvements.what: One structured Find item for a full $2\times2$ inverse with fractional entries and determinant working; one Verify item multiplying the proposed inverse by the original to obtain $I$. Give complete schemes and hints.

improvements.why: The determinant practice has only numeric evaluation and a fixed singular example; no unknown parameter is solved from a determinant condition.
improvements.what: Exam-style Find item: set $\det A$ equal to a given value (or zero for singularity) for a $2\times2$ matrix containing a parameter, solve the resulting linear equation, and justify the singular/non-singular conclusion.

improvements.where: note, after the inverse formula in ## Key ideas
improvements.why: The inverse check uses $I$ without defining its entries; the learner's YFM01 c5.1.pdf p.3 defines the $2\times2$ identity explicitly.
improvements.source: library: SaveMyExams/YFM01 further-pure-1/YFM01 c5.1.pdf p.3 and p.12
improvements.what: Add $I=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$, explain that it leaves a conformable matrix unchanged under multiplication, and show one row-column check from $AA^{-1}=I$.

improvements.why: The bundle records built successor 6 Transformations using matrices, but the note only names a topic in plain text.
improvements.what: Append the exact allowed link [[6 Transformations using matrices]] on the Leads to line; keep existing wording.
